verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a banking-as-a-service platform like Synctera, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export or offboarding capability in open formats. The 'complete data visibility' marketing line and the general record-management APIs are adjacent at best: an API a developer could use to pull records is a building block, not a documented export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
